Frequently asked questions,
answered
What is a game-based assessment?
Game-based assessments are physcometric tests that can be used as assessments for pre-hire or internal mobility
What types of competencies do game-based assessments measure?
Game-based assessments measure across three key competency domains:
Personality & Work Style
– How candidates approach tasks and responsibilities
Working with People
– Collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills
Working with Information
– Problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making
Can I combine a game-based assessment with interview questions?
Yes, with Hirevue you can interview and assess in one step. Combine game-based assessments with AI- scored interview questions for a complete experience that takes the candidate less than 20 minutes.
